title: STILL-PRESENT: B1 demolish-and-renumber pin — every resolve test demolishes the crisis's OWN bundle, never an unrelated preceding one
detail: The fixture has only pipes 0 and 1, the crisis's own bundle members; demolishing both exercises the identity-resolve branch, not the B1 hazard — a stored slot renumbering to a DIFFERENT surviving pair. The old slot code also resolves here, so the test cannot catch a regression.
recommended_fix: Add a test: crisis on pair B, demolish an unrelated earlier-bundle pipe so B's slot renumbers; pin no spurious resolve, no same-tick re-trigger, serialized slot follows pair B.

title: W5 wrong-typed archetype_id has no negative test row — only the unknown-id row is pinned
detail: The W5 code branch (non-string archetype_id → named load error) exists but no row feeds a numeric/bool/null archetype_id. The regression r1 filed could silently return since the branch is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add rows: archetype_id = 42 and archetype_id = true via replace1, expecting demand.json / "archetype_id must be a string".

title: Pool backstop coverage is PARTIAL — pinned only in the pool-stays-at-cap regime, not the marginal-pool regime
evidence:
core/crisis_test.odin:415-417: "// During the window the 20/tick surge keeps the pool at cap, so the E22\n// crisis persists until the window ends."

recommended_fix: Add a marginal-pool fixture: service ≥1/tick so the pool dips below cap at eval while still shedding; pin the expected crisis behavior explicitly.
